summary.intent: Verify PR #1246 locally by standing up the full web stack and supporting infra, extract the manual UAT steps from PR comments, and (after the user's follow-up) rebase the PR branch onto current main.
summary.outcome: Stood up the full local stack (API, mock routing store, Kubo, Postgres, two web preview bundles) and documented the #1247 UAT script; rebased the branch cleanly, but the rebase exposed a real regression on main (accelerator bearer sent to loopback gateways breaks CORS and silently stalls the write-plane drain); root-caused it via subagent trace, fixed `carries_credentials_safely` in crates/engine/src/content/read.rs to only trust TLS, verified against a stock gateway (977 engine tests, clippy, 13/13 e2e), filed issue #1280, updated and pushed the PR, then folded findings from a crypto/privacy review (added wire-level tests, tightened edge cases) and pushed a follow-up commit.

repo: cipherbox-mock-ipns-routing docker image is stale and sends no CORS headers; its Dockerfile also fails to rebuild (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 1 on ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS: esbuild@0.28.2) — run `node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js` on the host instead, matching what CI does

API per-IP auth throttle defaults to 10/min (apps/api/src/ops/throttling.ts:7); a full e2e run needs ~11 logins so it self-rate-limits locally unless THROTTLE_AUTH_LIMIT is raised — CI sets THROTTLE_AUTH_LIMIT=200 in web-e2e.yml, mirror this in apps/api/.env for local runs
Web has two preview bundles: :4173 is the e2e bundle with a console/window.__CIPHERBOX_ENGINE__ hook for scripted login, :4174 is the shipping bundle requiring interactive Google login only

A failed write-plane drain is silent: deadLetters stays empty, blocked is null, staleness reads 'fresh', and the UI footer reads 'synced' even though the child node is permanently pending — no dead-letter is created when Drain::load_scope_root halts on a gateway failure

crates/engine/tests/write_plane.rs uses ApiBaseUrl::offline() which skips provisioning by design (facade.rs:1776-1779), so no existing engine test composes 'first-run mint → queued write drains' against a real gateway; only the new web-e2e write-path specs could catch this class of regression

apps/web/src/engine/introspection.ts and packages/login/src/flow.ts both call handOffLoginSecret(facade, exporter) → facade.start(secret); provisioning lives inside start (facade.rs:1779), so the two login paths are equivalent

code.finding: carries_credentials_safely previously treated localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] as credential-safe (regression introduced in 892ca9981, PR #1243), so into_gateway attached the session JWT to loopback accelerator reads via Authorization header. Kubo's gateway CORS allowlist (Access-Control-Allow-Headers) does not include Authorization, so the browser preflight rejects the request, breaking every block read and stalling the drain in Drain::load_scope_root (crates/engine/src/sync/drain.rs:838-852). Fixed to only trust TLS (https://), falling back to GatewaySource::public otherwise.
Default per-IP auth rate limit is 10/min; local e2e runs need it raised (THROTTLE_AUTH_LIMIT=200) to match CI, or a full suite run self-throttles.

If MediaService.streaming is false or streamTicket returns null, save() silently falls back to the buffered blob download path instead of the streaming path, which can mask the streaming bug under test.

workflow: When a rebase surfaces unexplained e2e failures, bisecting pre-rebase vs post-rebase heads against the identical local stack quickly separates 'rebase mechanics broke it' from 'main introduced a real regression'

Reproducing a CI/browser-only failure by hand in Chrome via puppeteer (outside Playwright) helped isolate the exact failing network request (CORS preflight rejection on Authorization header) faster than reading test logs alone

AGENTS.md apparently mandates crypto/privacy and security subagent reviews for diffs touching credential handling before landing them; running both in parallel after the fix and folding real findings (added wire-level tests, tightened edge cases) before pushing is the expected workflow here
AskUserQuestion was used to decide fix placement (inside PR vs separate) before proceeding — worth confirming scope decisions like this before continuing invasive work

friction: Computer went to sleep mid-response during a long-running API restart, truncating the assistant's response and requiring the user to say 'please continue'
Mock IPNS routing docker container was stale/broken (no CORS headers) and its Dockerfile fails to rebuild, forcing a host-process workaround before any UAT could proceed
Local auth throttle defaults caused spurious e2e failures after the rebase that initially looked like rebase-induced regressions, requiring investigation to rule out
Diagnosing the post-rebase regression required a long-running background subagent trace (~13 minutes, 77 tool uses) plus manual bisection between pre- and post-rebase heads
open_items: Broken mock-ipns-routing Dockerfile (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails on ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS: esbuild@0.28.2) was noted but not fixed; offered to file an issue

Gap A from crypto/privacy review: the fix keys on scheme (TLS vs not) but the root cause (CORS) is scheme-independent — staging's accelerator must be confirmed to allow Authorization in its CORS response or it will brick the same way over TLS

Gap B from crypto/privacy review: a denied/downgraded accelerator credential fails silently (no event, no dead letter) and can widen the CID audience by rotating to public_fallbacks unauthenticated — recommended surfacing the denial once at construction, not yet implemented

Gap C from crypto/privacy review: GatewaySource.bearer and Gateway.accelerator are pub, so carries_credentials_safely only guards one call site; suggested a constructor-enforced invariant (GatewaySource::accelerator) was not confirmed implemented

Embedded-credentials URL edge case (e.g. user:pass@https://gw) still gets handed the bearer per the crypto review; flagged as worth an explicit reject on '@' in the authority or deliberate accept+test, not resolved
PR #1246 marked as draft; CodeRabbit review was skipped and full CI (beyond Lint/Tracker Refs/zizmor/PR title/Detect Changes) was still in flight at end of transcript
Manual browser UAT for #1247 (stream vs buffered download path) still needs to be actually performed by the user; stack was left running for this purpose
